arxiv-2104-13143.title: Existence and uniqueness of Rayleigh waves in isotropic elastic Cosserat materials and algorithmic aspects Thanks: Angela Madeo, Technische Universität Dortmund, August-Schmidt-Str. 8, 44227 Dortmund, Germany, email: angela.madeo@tu-dortmund.de
arxiv-2104-13143.creator: Hassam Khan, and, Ionel-Dumitrel Ghiba, and, and, Patrizio Neff
arxiv-2104-13143.description: Abstract We discuss the propagation of surface waves in an isotropic half space modelled with the linear Cosserat theory of isotropic elastic materials. To this aim we use a method based on the algebraic analysis of the surface impedance matrix and on the algebraic Riccati equation, and which is independent of the common Stroh formalism.

arxiv-2506-06266.title: Cartridges: Lightweight and general-purpose long context representations via self-study
arxiv-2506-06266.creator: Sabri Eyuboglu, Ryan Ehrlich, Simran Arora, Neel Guha, Dylan Zinsley, Emily Liu, Will Tennien, Atri Rudra, James Zou, Azalia Mirhoseini, Christopher Ré
arxiv-2506-06266.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sabri Eyuboglu, Ryan Ehrlich, Simran Arora, Neel Guha, Dylan Zinsley, Emily Liu, Will Tennien, Atri Rudra, James Zou, Azalia Mirhoseini, Christopher Ré. Large language models are often used to answer queries grounded in large text corpora ( e.g. codebases, legal documents, or chat histories) by placing the entire corpus in the context window and leveraging in-context learning (ICL). Although current models support contexts of 100K–1M tokens, this setup is costly to serve because the memory consumption of the KV cache scales with input length.

arxiv-2512-03099.title: QGShap : Quantum Acceleration for Faithful GNN Explanations
arxiv-2512-03099.creator: ​​Haribandhu Jena haribandhu.jena@niser.ac.in, Jyotirmaya Shivottam jyotirmaya.shivottam@niser.ac.in, Subhankar Mishra smishra@niser.ac.in
arxiv-2512-03099.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by ​​Haribandhu Jena haribandhu.jena@niser.ac.in, Jyotirmaya Shivottam jyotirmaya.shivottam@niser.ac.in, Subhankar Mishra smishra@niser.ac.in. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become indispensable in critical domains such as drug discovery, social network analysis, and recommendation systems, yet their black-box nature hinders deployment in scenarios requiring transparency and accountability. While Shapley value-based methods offer mathematically principled explanations by quantifying each component’s contribution to predictions, computing exact values requires evaluating 2 n 2^{n} coalitions (or aggregating over n ! permutations), which is intractable for real-world graphs.

arxiv-2601-06033.creator: Patrick Gage Kelley, Steven Rousso-Schindler, Renee Shelby, Kurt Thomas, Allison Woodruff
arxiv-2601-06033.description: Abstract . Generative AI (GenAI) is a powerful technology poised to reshape Trust & Safety. While misuse by attackers is a growing concern, its defensive capacity remains underexplored. This paper examines these effects through a qualitative study with 43 Trust & Safety experts across five domains: child safety, election integrity, hate and harassment, scams, and violent extremism.
